component.name: padne
component.summary: DC power delivery network analyzer for KiCad

description.p: padne is a KiCad-native power delivery network analysis tool. It uses the finite element method to simulate the voltage drop induced by DC currents on printed circuit boards. This allows easy identification of resistive bottlenecks, design of high-current distribution networks, or implementing complex heating elements.

ul.li: Uses the finite element method to quickly solve the Laplace equation
Control via text directives in your schematic files
Interactive Qt GUI to explore the computed solution, and ParaView export

screenshot.caption: Voltage drop in the interactive GUI
Voltage, current density and mesh visualizations
